summary: Backend and frontend regression testing completed for requested P0 timeline scope. Backend /api/archive validations passed (10/10). Timeline behavior, routing, controls, tabs, theming, desktop/mobile readability, wheel behavior, and exact-stop checks passed; one intermittent reduced-motion deep-link visibility race appeared once but did not reproduce in targeted reruns.

integration_issues.flow: Reduced-motion deep-link to #route-timeline during mixed viewport/reload sequence
integration_issues.issue: One run timed out with timeline section hidden despite URL hash route. Fresh reduced-motion rerun and explicit route call both passed, so issue is intermittent/flaky.

action_items: Investigate reduced-motion/hash routing timing race to eliminate intermittent hidden timeline state on reload sequences.
Ensure REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is exported in backend test runner env by default to avoid accidental pytest skips in future iterations.
critical_code_review_comments: All critical timeline controls in tested scope currently expose data-testid and were interactable in automation.
Exact timeline chapter stop remains stable at progress 0.305 (num=3660, den=12000) with data-traveling=false.
No duplicate critical timeline/team control data-testid values detected in DOM during targeted scan.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified in this run: /api/archive seasons=19 (2007-2025), victories=105, 2020 values 11/14/10/347 with matching achievement counts; timeline route active=timeline traveling=false; 1st/2nd/3rd/lower position colors differentiated; theme switches preserved position color; wheel from timeline routed to cars; desktop 1920x800 and mobile 390x844 had no horizontal overflow. One intermittent reduced-motion hidden timeline timeout occurred once in a mixed-state run but could not be reproduced in two targeted reduced-motion reruns.
rca of the issue: Intermittent frontend race condition suspected between hash-route handling, chapter visibility gating, and post-navigation state when reloading under changed media/viewport state. Symptoms: timeline section remained hidden once despite #route-timeline. Mitigation observed: explicit immediate route call via window.__spatialGo('timeline', { immediate: true }) and fresh reduced-motion load both restore expected visibility.
